today_summary: GCM26 marks $4,074.8 on the 2026-11-09 settle (ATM IV 22.16%, 16 DTE, 1-sigma daily $56.88 / 1.40%) — $38.6 below the 11-06 high of $4,113.4, so the two-session rally has stalled rather than extended. True max pain is $4,200 ($9.84M, the only interior minimum in the +/-$400 window) and sits +$125.2 above spot; the headline $5,225 print is an artifact of legacy upper-strike OI, since 147,513 contracts — 50% of all call OI — are parked at strikes >= $5,000. Gamma remains a dipole hinged on spot: net GEX sums -470.9 from $3,667-$4,075 but +316.7 from $4,075-$4,482, leaving the +/-$200 window at -131.1 (calls +418.4 / puts -549.5). Flow was barbelled, not directional — 4,079 calls traded above $4,400 against 149 puts, while 3,268 puts traded below $3,950 against 1,289 calls.
five_day_thesis: Five sessions ago (11-03) spot was $3,969.5 with window GEX at -92.3; the window closes at $4,074.8 for +$105.3, but the last three sessions have gone 4,072.9 -> 4,113.4 -> 4,074.8, so the move is now a plateau, not a trend. The regime change already happened and is now decaying: GEX flipped negative to positive on 11-05 (-157.3 to +167.7), peaked at +306.9 on 11-06, and has since bled -117.5 to +189.3 — dealers still dampen moves above spot, but with materially less force than three days ago. ATM IV round-tripped rather than trended, 22.29% -> 22.74% -> 20.99% -> 23.02% -> 22.16% for a net -0.13pp, so the 11-05 vol crush was a one-day hedge unwind and premium has already been rebid. The floor hardened while the ceiling stayed inert: the put wall settled at $3,700 for three straight sessions (6,630 OI) after oscillating 3,500 -> 3,900, total put OI grew +4,140 to 120,142 against only +1,455 calls, and the call wall never left $5,500 in any of the five sessions. Positioning over the window is therefore defence near the money plus far-OTM upside lottery tickets — the +645 call OI added at $4,550 and +309 at $4,450 sit two to four 1-sigma moves away with 16 DTE and do nothing to support spot.
what_changed: Spot — rolled over $38.6 from the 11-06 high of $4,113.4, ending the two-day advance and leaving $4,100 as a failed pivot rather than a reclaimed one.
GEX — window total decayed +306.9 -> +189.3 (-117.5) in one session; still positive for a third day but the long-gamma cushion above spot is thinning.
ATM IV — rebid +1.17pp off the 11-05 low (20.99% -> 22.16%) after peaking at 23.02%, confirming the vol crush was a one-day unwind, not compression.
Put wall — anchored at $3,700 for a third consecutive session (6,630 OI) while put OI rebuilt at $3,900 (+269) and $3,600 (+136); the floor is being defended nearer the money.
Call OI — +645 at $4,550 and +309 at $4,450, the largest one-day adds in the window, but both are far-OTM with 16 DTE and carry no spot support.
Max pain — the $4,200 interior minimum held a second session ($9.84M) even as spot faded, widening the magnet gap to +$125.2 from +$87 lower.
prediction: Bias cautiously constructive toward $4,200 only while spot holds the $4,075-$4,100 hinge. Above $4,100 (first materially positive strike, net GEX +19.0) the positive-gamma shelf running to $4,482 absorbs dips and the $4,200 max-pain magnet plus the $4,200-$4,350 call OI (5,271 and 6,109) is the path of least resistance. A close below $3,995 re-enters the short-gamma zone that sums -470.9 down to $3,667, reactivating the $4,000 node (5,074 put OI, net GEX -43.5) and then $3,950 and $3,900 (net GEX -50.7 and -71.9) — that is the level that invalidates the long.
